upheld.detail: loadScenario('prb-6') is called in both test.beforeAll and test.beforeEach; beforeEach already runs before the first test, so the beforeAll call is dead code that only adds an extra stack reload. No other teststack spec uses beforeEach.

upheld.title: Story has no ## Implementation Notes
upheld.detail: The PR implements PRB-6, but the story file contains only its title heading and no ## Implementation Notes section (Decisions, Deviations, Code map); the PR description does not provide them either.
upheld.requirement: PR check style guidelines: the story's ## Implementation Notes are present when the PR implements a story
